# Quality Control / Repository-only travel time and delta travel time grids
# for all 15 flood scenarios. Internal use only; not for supplement.

## Setup
```{r}
source(here::here("Code/utils/loading_utils.R"))
source(here::here("Code/utils/impact_utils.R"))
source(here::here("Code/00_scenario_definitions.R"))

load_processed_data()
```

## 1. Travel Time Raster Generation (All 15 scenarios)
```{r}
flood_tt_all_stack <- load_flood_scenarios(type = "all")
names(flood_tt_all_stack) <- scenarios_all$label_plot
```

## 2. Delta Travel Time Raster Generation (All 15 scenarios)
```{r}
x_delta_all_supp <- calculate_delta_stack(flood_tt_all_stack, base_tt_all)
names(x_delta_all_supp) <- scenarios_all$label_plot

save_delta_rasters(x_delta_all_supp, "processed/delta_travel_all")
```


## 4. Supplementary Table 2: Baseline Coverage Thresholds
```{r}
source(here::here("Code/utils/export_utils.R"))

# Define coverage thresholds of interest (minutes)
thresholds <- c(15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120)

# Function to calculate % population coverage for a given baseline raster
calculate_coverage <- function(base_raster, pop_raster, thresholds) {
  pop_aligned <- align_pop_to_tt(pop_raster, base_raster)
  
  pop_vals <- terra::values(pop_aligned, mat = FALSE)
  tt_vals <- terra::values(base_raster, mat = FALSE)
  
  # Total population in the study area (masking non-accessible areas if any)
  total_pop <- sum(pop_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  results <- sapply(thresholds, function(t) {
    sum(pop_vals[tt_vals <= t], na.rm = TRUE) / total_pop * 100
  })
  
  return(round(results, 1))
}

cov_all  <- calculate_coverage(base_tt_all, Worldpop_density, thresholds)
cov_hosp <- calculate_coverage(base_tt_hosp, Worldpop_density, thresholds)

table_s2_df <- data.frame(
  Threshold = paste0("≤ ", thresholds, " min"),
  All_Facilities = paste0(cov_all, "%"),
  Hospitals = paste0(cov_hosp, "%")
)

# Supplementary Table 2
# Title: Baseline population coverage across travel time thresholds.
# Caption: Proportion of the population with access to the nearest public or PNFP healthcare facility within specified travel time thresholds, 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, and 120 minutes, under baseline conditions.
ft_s2 <- flextable::flextable(table_s2_df) %>%
  set_header_labels(Threshold = "Travel Time Threshold",
                    All_Facilities = "All Healthcare Facilities",
                    Hospitals = "Hospitals Only") %>%
  theme_vanilla() %>% 
  bold(bold = FALSE, part = "all") %>%
  autofit()

save_manuscript_table(ft_s2, "Supplementary Table 2", subdir = "Supp", 
                      title = "Supplementary Table 2")
```
